The '''Raxus system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[star system]] in a [[sector]] known as the [[Tion Hegemony]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> It contained the [[planet]] [[Raxus Secundus]],<ref name="Tarkin" /> which served as the [[capital]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Raxus" />

==Description==
The Raxus system was a [[star system]] located in the [[Tion Hegemony]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> at grid square S-5 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="TFABG" /> Home to the [[planet]]s [[Raxus Secundus]]<ref name="Tarkin" /> and [[Raxus Prime]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> the Raxus system had a single [[star]],<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> and played host to several different [[species]], such as [[Gossam]], [[human]]s, [[Ithorian]]s, [[Leyakian]]s, [[Siniteen]], [[Twi'lek]]s, and [[Weequay]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

==History==
===Separatist Crisis===
In [[24 BBY]],<ref name="Raxus Address">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' states that the [[Raxus Address]] took place two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Battle of [[Geonosis]] to [[22 BBY]], therefore the Raxus Address must have occurred in [[24 BBY]].</ref> fallen [[Jedi]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]]<ref name="Rise">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref> gave a [[Raxus Address|speech]] in the Raxus system, where he commandeered a [[HoloNet]] [[HoloNet relay|relay station]] within the system.<ref name="Tarkin" /> In the speech, Dooku denounced the [[Galactic Republic]] as a futile enterprise that was burdened by corruption and favoritism toward the [[Core Worlds]]. Afterwards, the [[Serennian]] founded the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and began a [[Separatist Crisis|secessionist movement]] which resulted in thousands of star systems, including the Raxus system, leaving the Republic for the Confederacy.<ref name="Rise" />
